page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.t6-c1m4.large is a burstable instance type powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at 2.5 GHz with an x86_64 architecture. The instance is configured with 2 vCPUs derived from 1 physical core with hyper-threading enabled. It includes 8.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB per core. No local storage or dedicated GPU hardware is bundled with this configuration, and the baseline network bandwidth is rated at 0 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations place this instance in the lower performance tiers. The stress-ng single-core CPU performance score is 1161.28, categorized as weak, while the multi-core score drops to a poor rating of 2371.48. Memory bandwidth tests show 187.49 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 22.38 GB/sec for uncached large blocks. In application-specific tests, the instance achieves a Geekbench single-core score of 1092.0 and a multi-core score of 1822.0. Database operations and Redis SET benchmarks also reflect poor performance tiers, with Redis handling 2.61 million operations per second.

Given its burstable CPU allocation and modest hardware profile, this instance represents a budget-friendly option for workloads with low baseline CPU utilization that require occasional bursts. It is not suited for sustained high-performance computing, large-scale databases, or memory-intensive applications. Appropriate workloads include lightweight web serving, development environments, low-traffic microservices, and basic background tasks.
